sentences.en: We must go forward getting the better of all obstacles.
sentences.zh: 我们必须克服所有障碍继续前进。

sentences.en: The obstacles to our progress have been removed at last.
sentences.zh: 阻碍我们进步的障碍终于被移除了。

sentences.en: We have overcome the first obstacle with sorrow and distress.
sentences.zh: 我们怀着悲伤和痛苦克服了第一个障碍。

senses.zh: 障碍（物）,障碍物（绊脚石，障碍栅栏）

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ob（逆）+st（站）+acle（物）→反着站的物体→障碍，妨碍物
